title: Ila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Mishnah Bekhorot, chapter 4, mishnah 5. He lived in Yavneh and was an expert at examining firstborn animals’ blemishes. In Hyman’s account, because he was very pious, the sages permitted him to receive a fee: he was not suspected of declaring firstborn animals permitted merely for the payment.

notes.text: The reason for allowing the fee is that this expert would not be suspected of approving animals merely for payment. The notice does not grant a general exemption to others.
